profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: I am a full stack software engineer with many years supporting various projects ranging from Web UI development to service level development. I also have experience with leading teams as a software lead, architect, and Scrum Master. I am familiar with supporting different federal agencies and interested in works related to client/web applications, web services, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Primary role is backend Java developer for a web-based decision support application utilizing Java 8, Spring, Hibernate, ActiveMQ, Kafka, Bash Scripts, and Puppet
- Supports system integration with various internal / external sources
- Supports system deployment to various environments
- Supports team with various scrum duty
- Provides guidance to other developers / QAs about the system
- Designed and built CI/CD pipeline for the program using Jenkins and SonarQube

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Scrum master for an Agile Scrum development team.
- Supported operations team with day-to-day AWS activities such as EC2/S3 configurations and management.
- Supported operations team with maintaining the operation of deployed software on multiple cloud environments. Created and maintained Jenkins jobs that used by CM and Ops to package software for delivery and deployments to multiple AWS cloud environments.
- Designed and developed several important services for the program as a software lead / architect. Provided supports to other developers.
- Developed software in various languages such as Java and containerize them with Docker for usage in Linux environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
- Developed web applications in an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Primary responsibilities included maintaining and developing new features for current legacy application (C# ASP.NET, HTML, JavaScript) in Windows environment with Visual Studio and GUI libraries such as Telerik, Kendo UI, etc. Also worked with multi-tiered teams to develop new search portal application in Angular.
- Other secondary tasks involved monitoring and troubleshooting production issues, responding to customer's inquiries, collaborating with other teams to deliver products.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
- Participated in all phases of software development cycle using agile methodology with JIRA sprints and Kanban.
- Primary responsibilities included developing and maintaining legacy ASP.NET web applications in a large multi-tiered system. Worked with multiple popular web technology such as Telerik server controls, Kendo UI, AngularJS, etc.
- Other tasks involved monitoring and troubleshooting production issues, responding to inquiries from customers and users, collaborating with other teams to deliver products.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2 / Scrum Master
positions.description:
- Held Scrum Master position with a team of 6
- Develop SharePoint applications in an Agile/Scrum environment
- The majority of the work involve coding in various environments and languages (C#, JavaScript, CSS, PowerShell, Java)
- Primary tasks are developing (designs new or enhances existing functions) and maintaining (resolves build finding and fixes defects) various components for SharePoint 2007, 2010, 2013 (feature, web parts, scripts, etc...)
- Create custom SharePoint web parts, RESTFUL web services (Java, C#), APIs, JavaScript applications (Bootstrap, KnockoutJS, JQuery, etc)
- Experience with open source mapping technology with OpenLayers and related map features

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
- Primary responsibilities included design and development of Windows application software for VistA Imaging (VI), an image management system used by the Department of Veterans Affairs for their healthcare facilities
- Developed and tested new enhancements for VI Clinical Capture, Display, Telereader
- Designed and developed new application for VI such as Telepathology
- Maintained (bug fixes, upgrades) legacy software for VI
- Worked with sites to troubleshoot problems

positions.title: Embedded System Design
positions.description:
Smart Home Project: Anywhere Remote
Designed and developed a system that has a wireless remote which will let an user to operate their household systems (for example: home entertainment system) through gesture recognition

positions.title: Independent Study
positions.description: Worked on alternative user interface for computers. The goal is to develop an application that will use any type of video inputs and convert the video stream into mouse movements by reading the gesture of the user. The application would be beneficial to people that have limited mobility with their hands.

company.name: The Assistive Technology Research Initiative at Virginia Tech
